purpose: Generate deterministic CURRENT TREND feature states for the subset whose runtime classifier is already non-probabilistic, while leaving unapproved features as N/A rather than inventing thresholds.

market_bars.primary: Bitget USDT Futures BTCUSDT public candles
market_bars.reason: GitHub hosted runners can access the same Bitget futures venue already used by the V2.6 derivatives source; Binance USD-M public endpoint returned HTTPError in first shadow run and is not used as a silent fallback.

rules.STRONG_LONG: full bullish ordering close>EMA20>MA50>MA200 on both 1D and 4H
rules.STRONG_SHORT: full bearish ordering close<EMA20<MA50<MA200 on both 1D and 4H
rules.LONG: at least 4 of 6 bullish pair comparisons across 1D+4H and 1D is not full bearish
rules.SHORT: at least 4 of 6 bearish pair comparisons across 1D+4H and 1D is not full bullish

rules.NEUTRAL: mixed signs or any input equals 0

spot_etf_flow.trading_date_policy: use latest actual trading row; holidays/weekends are not fabricated

microstructure_confirmation.conflict_rule: if base direction and microstructure are opposite, emit NEUTRAL

derivatives_state.funding_extreme_suffix_policy: strip suffix for base mapping but preserve raw state in lineage
derivatives_state.24h_missing_policy: does not invalidate valid 1H/4H current category; never fill missing 24H
